仅处理明确日志目录内 14 天前的 .log、.txt、.xlog 文件。: Only .log, .txt, and .xlog files older than 14 days in explicit log folders are eligible.

图片、脚本和图形编译缓存。: Cached images, scripts, and compiled graphics.

npm 的内容缓存与历史日志。仅处理 7 天前的文件，不处理 node_modu: npm content caches and old logs, retaining the most recent 7 days. node_modules is excluded.

保留密码、收藏、历史记录、Cookie 和登录状态；再次访问网页时重新加载资源。: Passwords, bookmarks, history, cookies, and sign-in state are preserved. Web resources reload on the next visit.

播放歌曲、歌词和图片时产生的缓存，限定 QQMusicCache 目录。: Song, lyric, and image caches restricted to the QQMusicCache folder.
会失去部分离线缓存，歌曲可能需要重新联网加载。建议优先使用 QQ 音乐自带清理功: Some offline caches are lost and songs may require downloading again. Prefer QQ Music's own cleanup function.
软件安装、解压或运行产生的临时资料，只考虑 7 天前的文件。: Temporary data from installation, extraction, or app use. Only files older than 7 days are eligible.
某些软件可能保留临时工作资料。请先保存工作并关闭相关软件；正在占用的文件会跳过。: Some apps keep temporary work data here. Save your work and close those apps first. In-use files are skipped.

可能包含安装任务的中间资料，请确认没有安装或更新任务。通常需要管理员权限。: This may contain intermediate installation data. Ensure no installation or update is running. Administrator permissions are usually required.
应用异常退出时生成的诊断文件，不是运行必需文件。: Diagnostic files generated by app crashes, not required for normal operation.

电脑厂商预置的驱动和软件安装资料，可能用于恢复或重新安装。: Manufacturer-supplied driver and software packages that may be needed for recovery or reinstallation.

属于 Windows 正常运行使用的系统文件，不是垃圾。: System files used for normal Windows operation, not junk.
本工具不删除，也不修改相关系统设置。: Clarity does not delete these files or change their system settings.

访问页面时重新加载资源，保留浏览器配置。: Resources reload on the next visit. Browser settings are preserved.
请求界面的图形编译缓存。: Compiled graphics caches for request interfaces.
